SAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS ILUVIEN is a non-bioerodable intravitreal implant in a drug delivery system containing 0.19 mg fluocinolone acetonide, designed to release fluocinolone acetonide at an initial rate of 0.25 mcg/day and lasting 36 months.
